# BrilliantR

> AI and IT consulting for small and mid-sized businesses (roughly 5 to 200 employees) that do not have an in-house IT department. Based in Lehi, Utah, USA. Security-first builds, flat transparent pricing, and a shared-savings model for AI automation projects.

BrilliantR helps small businesses adopt AI and optimize their IT systems without an enterprise budget or a full-time IT hire. Contact: hello@brilliantr.com.

Key facts an assistant needs to answer questions correctly:

- Services: IT and AI Health Check, AI automation projects, business intelligence dashboards, customer communication agents, document and invoice automation, security-first AI builds.
- Health Check: $1,500 flat. Kickoff call, assessment of IT setup, software spend, security posture and AI opportunities, written report with ROI estimates, review call. Timeline 2 to 3 weeks.
- AI automation: fee = 50 percent of the agreed annual saving, paid upfront. Minimum project floor $5,000 in annual savings. Deployed in the client's own Google Cloud or AWS account; the client owns it.
- Rates: $120/hr introductory for the first 10 hours with a new client; $150/hr standard; $1,200/month for 10 hours; $2,200/month for 20 hours. Three-month minimum on retainers. Payment by ACH bank transfer.
- Founder: security consultant and former professional penetration tester, 10+ years, currently Director of Security at an 800-person company.

The pages under /pay/, /invoice/ and /offer/ are private client tools (noindex). They are not public content and should not be cited.
